notes.title: KSL Live World 2016 ~The Animation Charlotte & Rewrite~ is Now Available!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/635800][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30942356/663f2933b7c0f30d12144faf775b31ee46945c20.png[/img][/url]

Key loyalists and anisong lovers, rejoice! The full [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/635800]KSL Live World 2016 ~the Animation Charlotte & Rewrite~[/url][/b] concert experience is now available on Steam! 

Featuring 26 songs from Key's beloved franchises such as [b]Charlotte[/b], [b]Rewrite[/b], [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/623080]Planetarian[/url][/b], and [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/462990]Tomoyo After[/url][/b], this special concert film is fully subtitled in English and Chinese (Traditional and Simplified) with karaoke subtitles accompanying each song.
While watching the concert, you will also receive Steam trading cards featuring Charlotte and Rewrite characters! These trading cards can be used to craft special emoticons and backgrounds that you can use throughout the Steam community! :yusa:

The full [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/635800]KSL Live World 2016 ~the Animation Charlotte & Rewrite~[/url][/b] concert film is currently available for US$17.99, 10% off its normal price, until November 17th (PST). Also check out our catalog of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/VisualArts/list/35592]Key visual novels[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/VisualArts/list/39582/]soundtracks[/url] on Steam!

Be sure to follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/VisualArts]Steam developer page[/url] and on [url=https://twitter.com/VisualArtsUSA]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/VisualArtsUSA/]Facebook[/url]!

notes.title: Fixed some sound problems that occur under certain systems and correction of spell misses (Ver.1.2.2)
notes.content:
With this update a new sound feature is added. Additionally fixing several issues.

■ "Sound API" feature added
Under certain systems the first 1～2 seconds of voices or sound effects being played are delayed.
To avoid this we added the option "Sound API" inside the "System" tab of the "Config" menu.If this problem occurs with your system please change it from "WASAPI" to "DirectSound".

This change will take effect after you restart the game

(※Please understand that if you choose "DirectSound", some sounds may be cut off inside scenes with several sound effects occurring at the same time.)

■ Corrected about 110 spell-misses inside the English translation

■ Fixed the game occasionally becoming unstable during the baseball mini-game

notes.title: Fixed some problems that occur under certain systems and with specific settings (Ver.1.2.1)
notes.content:
[h1]The newest update fixes the following issues: [/h1]

[b] ■ If the BGM volume is set higher than default, the ending music wouldn't play[/b]
We solved the issue of the ending music not playing if the BGM volume in the game settings is set higher than "12".

[b]■ With certain systems, the game would stop during an effect inside Saya's route [/b]
We fixed the problem of the game stopping at some point inside Saya's route with certain systems.

[b] ■ When skipping movies some effects inside the main game are skipped as well[/b]
We solved the effect skipping issue inside Saya's route if you skipped the opening and ending movie of the game.

[b] ■ If during gameplay the sound device is being removed, the movie play speed is higher than default[/b]
We fixed the problem of movies playing too fast if you are removing your headphone or continuing the game without a sound device.

[b]■ When loading from a save file and selecting an option inside the meeting  before the baseball match, the game stops running[/b]
We fixed the issue that if you are saving during the meeting right before the baseball match and selected "Consult Kyousuke" or "Consult Rin", the game stopped running.

We apologize for the inconvenience. 
Thank you very much for your patience.

notes.title: Surround sound issues／Start-up issues with some Windows 7 systems have been fixed (Ver.1.2）
notes.content:
[h1]The newest update fixes the following issues: [/h1]

[b] ・Systems using surround sound configurations show an error message and the game stops running [/b]

Starting the game with sound settings of 2.1 channels or above(2.1/3.1/5.1/7.1) showed the following error message:

AudioClient->Initialize()
code : AUDCLNT_E_UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT 88890008

This issue has been fixed and the game sound output will be in stereo (2 channels).

[b] ・Although he minimum system specs are fulfilled, under some Windows 7 systems an error message shows up and the game stops running [/b]

With some Windows 7 systems, that fulfill the minimum system requirements, the graphic card driver has compatibility issues and shows the error message

[u]"DirectX11 initialization failed."[/u]

In some cases this message showed up and the game stopped running, but this issue has been resolved. (※ 1)

We apologize for the inconvenience.


※1
If even after this update the error message "DirectX11 initialization failed." shows up, this may be due to insufficient graphic cards specs; your card may not support "DirectX 11". 

Please follow these steps to check your graphic card's supported DirectX versions:

1. Push the Windows Key and search for "dxdiag" in the program/folder search bar.

2. When "dxdiag.exe" shows up please click the file

3. The DirectX diagnostics tool window will show up. Please click on the "Display" tab

4. On the right side of the window under "Driver" you can see the "DDI Version" that shows you the supported DirectX version of your graphic card. 
If it shows for example "9" your card only supports versions till "DirectX 9" and won't work under "DirectX 10".
To play Little Busters! English Edition the DDI Version has to be 10 or above.
(DDI Version 10 means DirectX 10 (Windows Vista generation) is supported on your graphic card).

Little Busters! English Edition needs a DDI 10 or above compatible graphic card. Following specs need to be fullfilled:
A graphic card supporting DirectX 10 or above / VRAM 512MB or more (GeForce 8400 or above, Radeon HD2400 or above)

If you still encounter problems please send us an email to our support address:
[i]vausa@product.co.jp[/i]

notes.title: About the “DirectX11 initialization failed” error message; game stops running
notes.content:
With the new update we changed the following features: 

[b]・After showing the error message “DirectX11 initialization failed” the game stops running [/b]

Inside the last update, with the intend to make the game more stable, we added the error message window 

 [b]”DirectX11 initialization failed.” [/b]

After showing this error message the game stops working (this is intended), but since this error doesn’t hinder the game from running, we decided to delete minor error messages inside the game. 

[b]・Even minor errors may lead to a slower game speed. If you encounter such problems (error messages included) please update your video card driver first[/b] 

[b]・Even with the newest video card driver the game may stop running and shows up an error message. In this case please send an email to our support address 
[i]vausa@product.co.jp. [/i][/b]

We apologize for the trouble caused with the last update and hope you will enjoy the rest of the game. We will keep the game up to date with further patches.

notes.title: Additional patch for full-screen mode; Info for users of Windows "N" and "KN"
notes.content:
[h1] ■ Patch Info  [/h1] 
With the new update the following issue has been fixed: 

[b]・On monitors with 4:3 aspect ratio or square monitors, in full-screen mode the game freezed in the system menu[/b]

This issue was due to problems in the last patch.
We apologize for the inconvenience.

 [h1] ■ For users of Windows "N" and "KN" [/h1] 
European and South Korean versions of Windows "N" and "KN" don't include
system packs needed to run the game and therefore show the error
message "An unhandled win32 exception occurred".
[u] Please download the "Media Feature Pack" of your "Windows N" or "Windows KN" edition (different feature packs for each windows version) at the "Microsoft support" website and install the missing features.[/u]

notes.title: Info regarding No Sound/Full screen Issues, Game Manual Info
notes.content:
We got several messages regarding sound issues 
(especially with surround sound card settings/headsets) 
and full screen mode (depending on monitor aspect ratio, resolution, etc.).

Using specific device drivers:

[b]- Sound isn't working at 3.1+ sound settings[/b]
[b]- On ultra-wide monitors, in full-screen mode the game freezes in the system menu[/b]

We are currently working on a patch to fix these issues.

As for the surround sound issues, please set your audio 
settings to "Stereo" (2.0) in the device manager of your system to avoid 
the no sound bug.

As for the wide-screen monitor freeze issue, please play the game
in "windowed mode" till we fix the problem.

We apologize for the inconvenience.


Also, don't forget to take a look at the game manual, including keyboard shortcuts like "L" to change the language or "Space" that let's you scroll the CGs to 4:3 ratio:

[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/635940/manuals/Little_Busters_English_Manual.pdf?t=1509520236] Game Manual[/url]
